name: Robert McGinnis
description: Robert Edward McGinnis (February 3, 1926 – March 10, 2025) was an American artist and illustrator celebrated for his prolific and stylish work in both publishing and film. Over a career spanning more than six decades, he created over 1,200 paperback book covers and more than 40 iconic movie posters , including Breakfast at Tiffany’s , Barbarella , and several James Bond films. Renowned for his elegant, often cinematic depictions—especially of strong, alluring women—McGinnis also illustrated for major magazines such as The Saturday Evening Post and Good Housekeeping . In 1993, he was inducted into the Society of Illustrators Hall of Fame , cementing his place among the greats of American illustration.
